pages.title: Episode 1, Page 1-1
pages.text: Episode 1, Page 1-1 is the first song on the first page of Comix Zone. Episode 1, "Night of the Mutants," begins in Newer York City, a ruined New York of the future, and soon reaches the Deceased District. Hardcore Gaming 101 points out a fallen Statue of Liberty in the page's second panel.

pages.title: Surf rock in the ruins
pages.text: Hardcore Gaming 101 hears a surf rock feel in the Comix Zone music, most of all in the first episode, with heavy metal and '90s grunge in other songs. Its writer says the main instrument, a kind of electric guitar, "sounds a bit grating at first" but fits the game well.

pages.title: Gravis meets his maker
pages.text: The first enemy Sketch Turner fights in Comix Zone is Gravis, a hulking brute. "Who are you?" Gravis asks. "Your maker, Gravis," Sketch answers, since he drew him. Gravis is voiced by the game's designer, Peter Morawiec.
